Lemna minor is a tiny aquatic plant found throughout the northern hemisphere and introduced in the southern hemisphere. With a large range extent, more than 1000 occurrences, abundant habitat, and broad habitat preferences, this species is considered secure.

taxon.wikipedia_summary: Lemna minor, the common duckweed or lesser duckweed, is an aquatic freshwater plant of the genus Lemna. They belong to the family of Lemnaceae, which is monophyletic to the Araceae family. L. minor is used as animal fodder, bioremediator, for wastewater nutrient recovery and other applications.
